title: Package source backed by a folder
description: nuget.config declares a source value of the `file:` scheme. A dependency resolved from a local path or a mutable branch is not the published artifact the rest of the project audits. This rule reads a source value of the `file:` scheme.
remediation: Depend on a published, versioned artifact, and keep local paths or branch references out of the committed manifest. Specifically: fix a source value of the `file:` scheme.
limitation: It matches a source value of the `file:` scheme in the parsed nuget.config; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
